articles.summary: Vancouver, British Columbia and Rehovot, Israel – June 18, 2026 – BioHarvest Sciences Inc (NASDAQ: BHST) (FSE: 8MV0), a leader in Botanical Synthesis technology and sustainable plant-based molecule development, today announced that it will present at the upcoming BIO International Convention, to be held on June 22-25, in San Diego, California. Presentation Details: Session: Company Presentation Date/Time: Wednesday, June
articles.title: BioHarvest Sciences to Present at the 2026 BIO International Convention
